problem: Native binary Word fixtures exposed attached-glossary end-sentinel and stylesheet-origin assumptions, lost revision toggles in editor enumeration, and stale shared glossary FIB pointers after otherwise valid main-story edits.
changes: Accept the ignored final PlcfGlsy sentinel at ccpText, as emitted by native Word. Real item endpoints remain strictly inside the text, ordered and UTF-16-boundary checked; duplicate/reversed/out-of-range sentinels remain errors.

Check LPStd alignment relative to the STSH record. The native attached stylesheet begins at Table-stream offset 9031 and has correctly aligned local records. A physically odd offset does not rescue malformed local alignment.

Revision enumeration now uses the semantic reader’s resolved ordered flag state, including 0x80/0x81 and later overrides, instead of searching for any literal 1. Valid revision ToggleOperands no longer generate Bool8 repair defects; actual Bool8 handling keeps its recorded fallback.

Synchronize both FIBs’ shared CHPX/PAPX pointers and cbMac after main-body publication, including deferred character-format publication. Validate the previously published template/glossary header coupling before writing; malformed input coupling is not silently repaired.

Add twelve DOC owner regressions and a public operations regression for native templates, macros, child files, encryption, comments, forms, moves, plain-body CRUD and exact inverse preservation. Correct the older subdocument test’s obsolete statement that the repository has no positive specimen.

verification_scope.catalog: 20 unencrypted DOC/DOT/extensionless-child variants plus one native encrypted DOC. Paragraph counts include all stories and table marks; table counts describe top-level tables.
verification_scope.source_edits: 13 title edits retain every unrelated CFB stream payload, source bytes, paragraph/table counts and exact inverse bytes. Native plain Unicode body creation/movement/removal, move accept/reject, and glossary-preserving deferred bold publication are separately exercised.
verification_scope.attached_glossary: Native LITCHI_AUTOTEXT_014 metadata and text, CP range [0,57), terminal/ignored/story-length tuple (57,58,58), Normal style, and selected paragraph/run formatting remain readable across body edits.
verification_scope.revisions: Native source/destination ranges [58,132) and [193,267), author Ryker Zhu, local 2026-10-15 20:07 DTTM and shared RSID 0x00EC3828. Accept and reject produce exact six-paragraph bodies and invert to the original source.
verification_scope.comments: Two native legacy comments retain their trailing carriage return, author, root/reply depth and parent index, local DTTM timestamps and absent ink flag.
verification_scope.forms: Stored FFData text/default/cache/help/length, checkbox default true versus undefined result, and dropdown item/default versus undefined selection. No UI state, macro or field execution.
verification_scope.encryption: Absent/wrong/correct credentials, exact five paragraphs, write-reservation Office42! metadata and ciphertext retention. Ordinary edits return the typed Encrypted refusal; encrypted body editing and rekeying are not claimed.
verification_scope.operations: Auto/Eager configured routes query the native template’s four paragraph paths and atomically edit two body paragraphs; a format-owner reopen confirms the attached AutoText content and identity, and the patch inverse restores the entire CFB.
verification_scope.negative_cases: Malformed in-memory derivatives of the native DOT exercise stale shared CHPX pointers and mismatched cbMac. The original fixture on disk is immutable.
